Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must be performed every 6 
months as indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Hesham El Sayed Mohamed El Assy, tested by eng. Mohamed Gad 
 El Rab Hawad at 29 March 2003, 
 reviewed by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abdel Momem El-Emam, accepted by general 
 director eng. Farouk Awad Aly, and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head Sector of 
 Talkha power plant.
Win_D 
is, like Send31, a part of program package PERTINAX and is also run directly 
from Windows 95 desktop, from folder Pertinax. It serves for send-in of 
application programs through serial line, through Profibus-FMS network and also 
for diagnosing of application programs directly in original graphic form.
Safety Precautions
Make Backup for soft
ware before work.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should be carry the suitable safety category,
